meta.name: Cascadia Coast: Thomas Creek
meta.author: fpv-sim contributors (data: USGS, USDA, OpenStreetMap contributors)
meta.description: The southern Oregon coast at Thomas Point, Samuel H. Boardman State Scenic Corridor: 1 m lidar terrain under a 0.8 m aerial photo, 60 m headland cliffs and sea stacks to dive, Sitka spruce forest, and the Thomas Creek Bridge (291 m long, 105 m over the creek) to fly under.
